story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. Brighton seafront: the pier and its shingle beach by the sea (kit place: beach); morning wind, afternoon, golden dusk
2. Grandfather's kitchen with a wooden table and a window (kit place: kitchen); morning light

On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier. A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner. Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest. Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper. At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread. Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind. Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember. In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm. Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves. She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy. At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.

bible.title: The Mended Kite
bible.logline: A torn kite teaches a girl and her grandfather that love can stitch the wind back together.

cast.name: Maya
cast.look: Eight-year-old girl with short chestnut hair, round face, wearing a mustard-yellow raincoat with a hood, teal wellies, and a small red kite string looped around her wrist.

cast.name: Grandfather
cast.look: Elderly man with silver hair, gentle wrinkles, wearing a navy-blue cardigan over a cream shirt, brown trousers, and round spectacles; a faint tattoo of a sail on his forearm.

cast.name: Kite
cast.look: Red diamond-shaped kite with a lightweight bamboo frame, red sailcloth, a long tail ribbon; initially intact, later a diagonal tear from corner to corner, then a neat sailor's seam patch, then a tiny gold star painted over the patch.

states.look: Bright red sail, no damage, tail streaming cleanly.
A long diagonal rip from the top‑left corner to the bottom‑right, sail flapping loose.
The tear closed with a tight sailor's seam of white sailcloth thread, visible stitching line.
The patched seam bears a small gold five‑point star painted over it.

cast.name: Brighton Seafront
cast.look: Wide shingle beach curving toward a Victorian pier with iron railings, gentle waves, morning wind whipping foam, golden dusk light painting the water amber.

cast.name: Grandfather's Kitchen
cast.look: Cozy cottage kitchen with a sturdy wooden table by a sash window, morning light spilling onto a checkered tablecloth, a kettle and a newspaper folded beside a jar of tea.

shots.description: Establishing view of Brighton seafront at windy autumn morning; Maya stands on the shingle beach, holding the string of her red kite which soars high above the pier railings.
shots.dialogue: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier.

shots.description: Close‑up on the kite as a sudden gust slams it into the iron railings; the red sail tears cleanly from corner to corner, fibers fluttering in the wind.
shots.dialogue: A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner.

shots.description: Maya runs along the shingle beach toward home, the broken kite hugged tightly to her chest, wind tugging at her raincoat.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest.

shots.description: In the warm kitchen morning light, Grandfather sits at the wooden table, newspaper lowered, looking up with gentle curiosity as Maya enters.
shots.dialogue: Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper.

shots.description: Over Grandfather's shoulder: the kite laid flat on the table, his hands threading a needle with white sailcloth thread, ready to stitch.
shots.dialogue: At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread.

shots.description: Extreme close‑up on the needle pulling thread through the torn sail; Grandfather points to each stitch, Maya watches intently.
shots.dialogue: Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind.

shots.description: Detail insert: Maya's small paintbrush adds a tiny gold star over the fresh seam; the star glints in the morning light.
shots.dialogue: Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember.

shots.description: Afternoon light on the seafront; Maya and Grandfather walk side by side along the wet sand, the mended kite tucked under Grandfather's arm.
shots.dialogue: In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm.

shots.description: Low angle looking up: Maya sprints into the strengthening wind, the kite surges higher than ever, its tail streaming over the rolling waves.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves.

shots.description: Two‑shot of Maya and Grandfather on the sand; Maya hands the kite string to him, both laughing like children as the kite dances overhead.
shots.dialogue: She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy.

shots.description: Golden dusk bathes the beach; Maya and Grandfather stroll home along the sand, the mended kite resting on Maya's shoulder, its gold star catching the last light.
shots.dialogue: At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.
